title: A Message from London
text:
Hi Anna! How are you? I am in London now. The weather is cold, but the city is very nice. I visit my friend Tom every day.

I have a new job here. I work in a small café. My boss is kind, and my colleagues are friendly. I want to visit you in June. Write to me soon!

questions.text: What kind of work does the writer do?
What can the reader infer about the writer's new job?
options: It is pleasant and the people are nice

questions.text: How does the writer probably feel about Anna?
options: The writer is angry with Anna
The writer does not know Anna
The writer misses Anna and wants to see her

vocabulary.definition: the conditions outside, such as sun, rain, wind or cold
friendly, caring and good to other people
a small place where you can buy drinks and simple food

paragraph_translations: Merhaba Anna! Nasılsın? Şu an Londra'dayım. Hava soğuk, ama şehir çok güzel. Her gün arkadaşım Tom'u ziyaret ediyorum.
Burada yeni bir işim var. Küçük bir kafede çalışıyorum. Patronum nazik ve iş arkadaşlarım arkadaş canlısı. Haziran ayında seni ziyaret etmek istiyorum. Bana yakında yaz!
